summary: Prime Medicine, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten primary offering of 35,714,286 common shares at $3.50 per share, grossing $125,000,001 before $7.5 million in underwriting discounts, for net proceeds of $117.5 million excluding expenses. The November 9, 2026 reference close was $4.30, implying roughly an 18.6% discount. Jefferies, TD Cowen and Goldman Sachs LLC are joint book-running managers, with Oppenheimer and LifeSci Capital passive; a 30-day option covers up to 5,357,142 additional shares. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and follow-on pricing pressure.
